生成された動画：=== REFERENCES ===

Use the provided images as visual guidance for Riven and her father.

Use the provided final frame from the previous sequence
to establish the beginning of this scene.

Keep the scene focused only on Riven and Father.


=== TECHNICAL ===

16:9 cinematic live-action dark fantasy.

Burning village at dusk.

Natural human movement.

Natural English dialogue with clear visible lip sync.

Quiet, intimate cinematic camera.

No combat.

No subtitles.

No background music.


=== DIALOGUE RULE ===

This is a TWO-PERSON conversation.

Riven and Father BOTH speak.

Each line must be spoken only by the character assigned to it.

When Father speaks, Riven stays silent and listens.

When Riven speaks, Father stays silent and listens.

Riven's dialogue is spoken aloud by adult Riven on camera.

Riven's lines are NOT voice-over.

Do not let Father speak Riven's lines.


=== SCENE ===

Begin with Riven kneeling close beside Father.

Father is weak and injured,
resting against the collapsed wooden debris.

His hand is touching Riven's face.

They look at each other.


Father speaks softly:

"You came back."


Father stops speaking.

Riven looks directly at him.

Riven now speaks aloud:

"I came too late."


Riven stops speaking.

A brief silence.


Father looks at Riven and asks:

"Do you remember what I told you?"


Father stops speaking.

Riven listens.

Riven becomes emotional.

Riven now answers him aloud:

"Protect those who can't protect themselves."


Riven stops speaking.


Father gives her a small, tired smile.

Father quietly says:

"Then keep going."


Father stops speaking.


His strength begins to fade.

The hand touching Riven's face
slowly slips downward.

Riven catches his hand.


Riven looks at him and speaks:

"Father?"


No response.


Riven waits.

Father does not move.


Riven realizes what has happened.

Very softly, Riven speaks one final time:

"Father..."


She remains beside him,
holding his hand.

Her grief is quiet.

Hold on Riven and Father together.

CUT.、16:9
